name: AnimeFesta
summary: Official Japanese streaming hub behind the iconic dual-version 'Broadcast vs Uncut Premium' spicy/adult anime adaptations.
ranking_rationale: Canonical Japanese home of top TL, BL, and romance spicy anime OVAs, though international viewers rely on English partner portals like OceanVeil or Coolmic.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Canonical Japanese home of top TL, BL, and romance spicy anime OVAs
Streams both mild broadcast cuts and full uncut versions legitimately
Smooth mobile & desktop dark video UI
cons: Japanese-only interface requiring domestic cards (use OceanVeil/Coolmic in English)
